description:
Use when the person has a home or auto declarations page, to fill in create_quote's fields from it instead of asking for each one. Takes the person's email and the page (PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to 10 MB) from exactly one source: document_url when the person gave a link to the file; for a file attached in the chat, call request_document_upload first and pass the upload_id it returned once the person has uploaded it; document_base64 only for a small file you already hold as bytes. Returns the detected product line, the create_quote fields it found, and missing_required: the fields to ask the person for before calling create_quote.

Eventual's Premium Lock is a service that provides useful tools, trackers, and predictions about your future home and auto insurance renewals. This service includes an accuracy guarantee: if your actual insurance premiums exceed Eventual's predictions, you'll be reimbursed for the overage! Reimbursements occur after your underlying insurance policy renews after each insurance policy period, for the next three years. Eventual's predictions are flexible and helpful, and stay put even if your carrier raises rates, coverage limits, or if you have an accident, insurance claim, or driving ticket. Of course, Eventual may update its predictions if you take action to manually increase your insurance prices. This includes when you lower your insurance deductible, add insurance endorsements, raise insurance coverage limits, remove insurance discounts, change insurance policy forms, or move to a more expensive insurance carrier. See Eventual's Terms of Service for full eligibility & exclusions. Premium Lock is not insurance or a financial derivative. Prices are set by Eventual's own pricing, not by the assistant. The person pays on eventualclimate.com; the assistant never charges anyone. Send only the fields a tool lists; never send conversation content or anything else about the person.

Gathering order: first ask for the consumer's email. Then look for their home or auto declarations page in their email and files; if you find one, send it to read_declarations_page and pass the fields it returns to create_quote. Otherwise ask the consumer for the fields create_quote needs.

Before any purchase, show the consumer every disclosure in the quote's required_disclosures word for word. Currently:
- Premium Lock is not a car insurance policy. It does not insure your car against collision or accident, or any other peril or loss.
- Eventual does not pay your car insurance premiums for you. You must keep paying your premiums to your insurance carrier, agent or lender.
- Premium Lock provides useful tools for insurance tracking, budgeting, and predictions. This service includes an accuracy guarantee. It is not insurance or a financial derivative.
- Reimbursements are made only when an eligible renewal comes in above your Payout Threshold, and are extinguished once reimbursements cumulatively hit your Cumulative Maximum Reimbursement.
- Premium Lock is governed by the Premium Lock Terms of Service.
- Premium Lock is not a home insurance policy. It does not insure your home against fire, theft, wind, hail, flooding, earthquake, or any other peril or loss.
- Eventual does not pay your home insurance premiums for you. You must keep paying your premiums to your insurance carrier, agent or lender.
- Premium Lock is not an insurance policy. It does not insure your home or your cars against fire, theft, wind, hail, flooding, earthquake, or any other peril or loss.
- Eventual does not pay your home and car insurance premiums for you. You must keep paying your premiums to your insurance carrier, agent or lender.
- Reimbursements are made only when an eligible renewal comes in above each insurance policy's Payout Threshold, and are extinguished once reimbursements cumulatively hit each insurance policy's Cumulative Maximum Reimbursement.

document_base64.description: The file's bytes, base64 encoded. Only for a small file you already hold as bytes.

document_url.description: A public https link to the file, as the person gave it. Eventual downloads it.

upload_id.description: The upload_id request_document_upload returned, once the person has uploaded the file. The email must be the one that link was requested for.
